chunks.text:
[Intro]
{a sunrise call: a rising harp sweep and a bright string chord as the sun clears the hills, the lead boldly announcing the hometown theme's first notes, into the theme}
positive_styles: bright warm pulse-wave lead singing the hometown lullaby with confidence
gentle present groove with soft kick and brush
triumphant sunrise homecoming, joyful and warm with a tear in its eye

chunks.text:
[Main Theme]
{the hometown lullaby melody stated whole and confident in bright C major, harp flowing, bass walking with a warm stride}
positive_styles: bright warm pulse-wave lead singing the hometown lullaby with confidence
gentle present groove with soft kick and brush
triumphant sunrise homecoming, joyful and warm with a tear in its eye

chunks.text:
[Main Theme Reprise]
{the same melody again with a soaring flute counter-melody weaving above and the strings fuller, like the whole town singing along}
positive_styles: bright warm pulse-wave lead singing the hometown lullaby with confidence
gentle present groove with soft kick and brush
triumphant sunrise homecoming, joyful and warm with a tear in its eye

chunks.text:
[Bridge]
{contrast: the old wistful answer phrase reborn in F major, tender and grateful, softer groove, then a rising build of harp and strings back toward the theme}

chunks.text:
[Main Theme Return]
{the lullaby returns in full radiant bloom with bells and counter-melody together; the last bar leads straight back into the theme, no ending}
